description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeMembershipSearchFilterParams class within the OrangeHRM project. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies filtering parameters, particularly for searching employee memberships based on employee number and sorting by name.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) extending FilterParams to handle search filtering for employee memberships, allowing sorting by member name and filtering by employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters by setting the default sort field to member name.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number filter criterion, if set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.
